value.quote: pure strategies that form a subgame perfect equilibrium (SPE)
value.note: The paper defines equilibrium only as SPE. The second-stage vote-trading equilibria are solved by best responses as part of the SPE, and Nash equilibrium is never named as a separate concept.

C8.1.reason: The paper's only stated solution concept is SPE, and the subgame equilibria are components of that SPE rather than a separately named Nash concept, so adding NE goes beyond what the paper says.
